customer: I commute over 100 miles a day in my SUV, so there's no way I can keep the mileage down while I wait to bring it in for the appraisal. Does my offer just die if I go past some mileage cap? This is really frustrating since I live in Georgia and can't exactly stop driving to work.
agent: I understand the frustration, especially with a long commute. Per our article "How long is my offer good for?", your offer is valid for 7 days or 300 additional miles, whichever comes first, and you can find the expiration date on your offer page and in your confirmation email. We'll honor the offer as long as your appraisal appointment is on or before that expiration date, so booking the earliest appointment you can is your best bet. If the offer does expire, you can request a new one at any time, though the new amount will reflect current market prices and may be higher or lower.
